name: History
description: People and events that shaped the world.
theme: world history from antiquity to the late twentieth century: rulers and revolutions, wars and treaties, exploration, invention, and the everyday life of past societies
angles: what a famous ruler is actually remembered for, beyond the name
the specific year or decade a well known event happened
treaties and agreements, and what each side gave up
the cause behind an event people only know the outcome of
everyday life, what people ate, wore, earned or died of
inventions and who got there first, including disputed claims
empires at their height, how far they reached and what ended them
explorers and where they actually landed rather than where they aimed
the origin of a phrase, custom or object that survives today
two events people routinely place in the wrong order
revolutions and the immediate trigger that set them off
history outside Europe and North America, given equal weight
figures who were famous in their own time and are forgotten now
the surprisingly short or long duration of a well known thing
avoid: contested or politically live topics, atrocity and body counts, questions that turn on a date nobody could reason toward
